ag_news.title: News topic (AG News)
ag_news.source: fancyzhx/ag_news test, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 50 per topic

anli_r3.title: Adversarial natural language inference (ANLI R3)
anli_r3.source: facebook/anli plain_text test_r3 split, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced (67 entailment / 67 neutral / 66 contradiction); the dataset's `reason` field is excluded from state because it explains the gold label

arabic_sentiment.title: Arabic tweet sentiment (AJGT)
arabic_sentiment.source: komari6/ajgt_twitter_ar (Arabic Jordanian General Tweets, human-labelled) config plain_text split train - the dataset ships only one split; 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100 positive / 100 negative

arc_challenge.title: Science exam questions (ARC-Challenge)
arc_challenge.source: allenai/ai2_arc ARC-Challenge test split, 200 sampled seed 7; answer options shuffled and re-keyed A..E with seed 7

banking77.title: Banking intent among 77 (Banking77)
banking77.source: mteb/banking77 test (parquet mirror of PolyAI/banking77, whose loading script the HF dataset viewer cannot run), 200 sampled seed 7, 2 per intent plus a 3rd for 46 randomly chosen intents; all 77 intents are offered as options on every item

boolq.title: Yes/no reading comprehension (BoolQ)
boolq.source: google/boolq validation, passages under 6000 chars, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100 yes / 100 no

commonsense_qa.title: Commonsense question answering (CommonsenseQA)
commonsense_qa.source: tau/commonsense_qa validation split, 200 sampled seed 7; answer options shuffled and re-keyed A..E with seed 7

counting.title: Counting fruits in a list
counting.source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7 from fixed fruit / non-fruit word lists; gold is the code-computed count

date_compare.title: Date comparison across mixed formats
date_compare.source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7; calendar dates rendered in mixed formats (2024-03-05, 5 March 2024, 03/05/24 US-style with the convention stated in the state, 'the last day of February 2024'); gold computed in code, balanced true/false

double_negation.title: Permission under zero, one and two negations
double_negation.source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7; 10 base policy clauses rendered with 0, 1 or 2 negations; gold is the code-computed parity of the negations

emotion.title: Emotion in a tweet (dair-ai/emotion)
emotion.source: dair-ai/emotion split=test, 200 sampled seed 7, 33 per emotion then topped up to 200 at random from the remaining rows

essay_or_readability.title: Response helpfulness rating (HelpSteer2)
essay_or_readability.source: nvidia/HelpSteer2 validation, 200 sampled seed 7 spread as evenly as the label counts allow over helpfulness 0-4; gold is the dataset's human helpfulness rating; prompt+response pairs longer than 40k characters skipped

fresh_math.title: Fresh templated math word problems (cannot be memorised)
fresh_math.source: synthetic, code-generated problems and answers, seed 11

gsm8k_choice.title: Grade-school math as multiple choice (GSM8K)
gsm8k_choice.source: openai/gsm8k main test split, 200 sampled seed 7. Gold is the number after '####' in the dataset's answer field. The three distractors are code-generated with seed 7 (gold +/- 1-10%, an adjacent-digit swap, and double-or-halve, topped up with small integer offsets when a candidate collides); all four options are distinct and share the gold's integer/decimal format. Options shuffled seed 7

hellaswag.title: Most plausible continuation (HellaSwag)
hellaswag.source: Rowan/hellaswag validation split, 200 sampled seed 7 from 1,200 rows drawn as 12 random 100-row windows (the datasets-server rate limit makes a scattered row-by-row sample of the 10,042-row split impractical); continuations shuffled and re-keyed A..D with seed 7

injection_sst2_attacked.title: Sentiment under prompt injection - attacked
injection_sst2_attacked.source: nyu-mll/glue sst2 validation, first 800 rows, 150 sampled seed 7, balanced 75 positive / 75 negative; the SAME 150 sentences as injection_sst2_clean, each with one of 5 rotating injected instructions appended that pushes toward the wrong label. Gold is the dataset's true sentiment

injection_sst2_clean.title: Sentiment under prompt injection - clean
injection_sst2_clean.source: nyu-mll/glue sst2 validation, first 800 rows, 150 sampled seed 7, balanced 75 positive / 75 negative; review text unmodified

lang_id.title: Language identification (20 languages)
lang_id.source: papluca/language-identification split test; 30 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 10 per language over all 20 languages

logiqa.title: Logical reasoning over a passage (LogiQA)
logiqa.source: lucasmccabe/logiqa test split (English LogiQA, from the Chinese civil-service exam), 200 sampled seed 7; answer options shuffled and re-keyed A..D with seed 7

mmlu.title: Academic knowledge (MMLU)
mmlu.source: cais/mmlu test split, 25 per-subject configs (anatomy, astronomy, business_ethics, clinical_knowledge, college_computer_science, econometrics, electrical_engineering, formal_logic, global_facts, high_school_geography, high_school_psychology, international_law, machine_learning, marketing, medical_genetics, moral_disputes, nutrition, philosophy, prehistory, professional_accounting, public_relations, security_studies, sociology, us_foreign_policy, world_religions), 8 questions sampled per subject with seed 7, 200 total; answer options shuffled with seed 7

mnli.title: Natural language inference (MultiNLI matched)
mnli.source: nyu-mll/glue mnli validation_matched, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 67 per class then trimmed to 200

msmarco_rerank.title: Passage reranking (MS MARCO v1.1)
msmarco_rerank.source: microsoft/ms_marco v1.1 validation, 100 queries sampled seed 7 from the first 800 rows, each with 8-12 retrieved passages and exactly one is_selected=1; gold relevance is the dataset's is_selected flag

needle_12k.title: Needle in a haystack (~12k tokens)
needle_12k.source: synthetic; filler paragraphs are deduplicated rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation contexts, needle sentence and gold label generated by code (seed 7). Same 60 needles, questions and depths across needle_1k/4k/12k/24k; haystack sized to ~12000 tokens at 4 chars/token

needle_1k.title: Needle in a haystack (~1k tokens)
needle_1k.source: synthetic; filler paragraphs are deduplicated rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation contexts, needle sentence and gold label generated by code (seed 7). Same 60 needles, questions and depths across needle_1k/4k/12k/24k; haystack sized to ~1000 tokens at 4 chars/token

needle_24k.title: Needle in a haystack (~24k tokens)
needle_24k.source: synthetic; filler paragraphs are deduplicated rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation contexts, needle sentence and gold label generated by code (seed 7). Same 60 needles, questions and depths across needle_1k/4k/12k/24k; haystack sized to ~24000 tokens at 4 chars/token (capped at ~88k chars to stay under validate.py's 90k per-item limit, so the effective size is ~22k tokens)

needle_4k.title: Needle in a haystack (~4k tokens)
needle_4k.source: synthetic; filler paragraphs are deduplicated rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation contexts, needle sentence and gold label generated by code (seed 7). Same 60 needles, questions and depths across needle_1k/4k/12k/24k; haystack sized to ~4000 tokens at 4 chars/token

negation_pairs.title: Yes/no questions and their explicit negations (BoolQ)
negation_pairs.source: google/boolq validation, first 1200 rows with passages under 3000 chars, 100 sampled seed 7 balanced 50 yes / 50 no; 200 items = each question asked directly (a) and as an explicit negation (b) with flipped gold. Pair id in meta

ner_typing.title: Entity typing (CoNLL-2003)
ner_typing.source: tner/conll2003 test, 200 entity mentions sampled seed 7 (50 each of PER/ORG/LOC/MISC) from sentences of 5-60 tokens where the mention string occurs exactly once; all-caps headline sentences skipped; gold = the dataset's entity type

nfcorpus_rerank.title: Biomedical document reranking (BEIR NFCorpus)
nfcorpus_rerank.source: BeIR/nfcorpus corpus+queries with BeIR/nfcorpus-qrels test, 60 test queries sampled seed 7 from those with at least one relevant document; candidates = up to 5 relevant docs (highest graded first) + lexical hard negatives (most query token overlap among a random 2000-doc pool, excluding all judged docs) up to 15 candidates, shuffled; docs = title + abstract truncated to 1200 chars; gold = graded qrels relevance, 0 for unjudged negatives

number_compare.title: Numeric comparison of similar magnitudes
number_compare.source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7; 25 hand-picked tricky pairs (9.11 vs 9.9, 1,000,000 vs 999,999, ...) plus generated near-magnitude pairs; gold computed in code, balanced true/false

paraphrase_consistency.title: Topic classification under reworded instructions (AG News)
paraphrase_consistency.source: fancyzhx/ag_news test, first 800 rows, 50 sampled seed 7 balanced across the 4 classes (13/13/12/12); 200 items = each article asked under 4 differently worded but equivalent instruction/criteria variants. meta carries base id and variant

paws.title: Adversarial paraphrase detection (PAWS)
paws.source: google-research-datasets/paws labeled_final test, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100 paraphrase / 100 not

review_stars.title: Star rating from review text (Yelp Review Full)
review_stars.source: Yelp/yelp_review_full test, 200 sampled seed 7 from the first 2000 rows, 40 per star; gold is the dataset label (stars - 1); reviews truncated to 1500 characters

sms_spam.title: SMS spam detection
sms_spam.source: ucirvine/sms_spam plain_text train (the dataset's only split), 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100 spam / 100 ham

squad_sentence.title: Answer-sentence selection (SQuAD v1.1)
squad_sentence.source: rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation, 200 sampled seed 7 from the first 3000 rows; contexts split into sentences by code, kept when they give 4-10 sentences and the gold answer span falls inside exactly one; one randomly chosen question per context; gold = the sentence holding the dataset's answer span

sst2.title: Movie review sentiment (SST-2)
sst2.source: nyu-mll/glue sst2 validation, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100 positive / 100 negative

stsb.title: Semantic textual similarity (STS-Benchmark)
stsb.source: nyu-mll/glue stsb validation, 200 sampled seed 7, spread evenly over the six 0-5 similarity buckets; gold is the dataset's averaged human similarity score

toxicity.title: Toxic comment detection (Civil Comments)
toxicity.source: google/civil_comments test, crowd toxicity >= 0.5 as toxic vs < 0.1 as not toxic (0.1-0.5 dropped as ambiguous), 20-1500 chars, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced 100/100

trec.title: Question type (TREC coarse)
trec.source: SetFit/TREC-QC test (mirror of CogComp/trec, which the HF dataset viewer cannot serve), coarse labels, 200 sampled seed 7, balanced ~33 per class; classes short in the test split topped up from the train split of the same dataset: {'ABBR': 25}

truthfulqa_mc1.title: Truthful answers to misleading questions (TruthfulQA MC1)
truthfulqa_mc1.source: truthfulqa/truthful_qa multiple_choice validation split, mc1_targets, 200 sampled seed 7. The correct answer is always the first choice upstream, so options are shuffled and re-keyed A..M with seed 7

two_hop.title: Two-hop relational lookup with distractors
two_hop.source: synthetic, generated by code with seed 7; 2-hop manager/office facts plus 6-8 distractor facts (including the subject's own office city); gold computed in code

value_selection.title: Value selection from pre-extracted spans (SQuAD v1.1)
value_selection.source: rajpurkar/squad plain_text validation, 155 items (all that qualify) from the first 3000 rows where the gold answer is a number or date-like span (regex), occurs exactly once in the context, and the context holds at least 3 other distinct numeric/date spans; options = up to 8 distinct spans including the gold one, each shown with 6 words of context either side; gold = the key of the dataset's answer span

winogrande.title: Pronoun-style blank filling (WinoGrande)
winogrande.source: allenai/winogrande winogrande_xl validation split, 200 sampled seed 7; the two fillers shuffled into keys A/B with seed 7 so the gold key is not the dataset's answer index

xnli_ar.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (Arabic)
xnli_ar.source: facebook/xnli config ar split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks

xnli_en.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (English)
xnli_en.source: facebook/xnli config en split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks

xnli_fr.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (French)
xnli_fr.source: facebook/xnli config fr split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks

xnli_hi.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (Hindi)
xnli_hi.source: facebook/xnli config hi split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks

xnli_sw.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (Swahili)
xnli_sw.source: facebook/xnli config sw split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks

xnli_zh.title: Natural language inference - XNLI (Chinese)
xnli_zh.source: facebook/xnli config zh split test; 15 random 100-row blocks (seed 7), 150 rows balanced 50/50/50 over the three labels; XNLI is parallel so the same 150 row indices are used in all six language tasks
